title: Answer: no account of intelligence, and goals are left out of the definition of an agent

statements.text: The conscious agent program takes no position on what intelligence is. Goals and goal-directed behavior are left out of the definition of a conscious agent, which allows agents with no goals and treats goals as no defining property of consciousness. Goal-directed behavior can still arise, since dynamical systems of conscious agents can build universal Turing machines.
statements.scope: Objects of consciousness (2014), which defines the conscious agent

sources.quote: Goals and goal-directed behaviors are not in the definition of conscious agent.
